request: Add an ordinal helper (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 11th) for the scoreboard, handling 11–13 correctly, with tests.

summary.result_text:
I couldn't run the tests, because the command needs your approval and wasn't run. So `ordinalize` and its tests are untested. To check them, run `python -m pytest tests/utils/test_humanize.py -q` from the repo root.

`ordinalize` already had callers, but `CTFd/utils/humanize/numbers.py` was effectively empty. `CTFd/models/__init__.py` imports it to produce the 1st/2nd place text for users and teams. The existing `test_ordinalize` imports it too. I wrote the function there instead of adding a new helper, so the scoreboard code gets it without changes.

- **Helper:** `ordinalize(n)` returns `n` plus `st`, `nd`, `rd` or `th`. It uses `th` when `abs(n) % 100` is 11–13, so 11th, 12th, 13th, 111th and 112th come out right. Otherwise it picks the suffix from the last digit.
- **Tests:** I added `test_ordinalize_teens_and_edges` to `tests/utils/test_humanize.py`. It covers 0, 10, 20–23, 100, 112, 113, 211, 1011, 1021 and the string `"5"`.
- **Catalog:** The pattern catalog has nothing that fits an ordinal helper, so I wrote it normally. That means there was no pattern to check the code against.
